scripts.build:widgets: npm run build:widget -w login && npm run build:widget -w cart
scripts.dev: npm run build:widgets && concurrently -k -n home,products,login,cart -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w home" "npm run dev -w products" "npm run dev -w login" "npm run dev -w cart"
scripts.build: npm run build:widgets && npm run build -w login && npm run build -w cart && npm run build -w home && npm run build -w products
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n home,products,login,cart -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run start -w home" "npm run start -w products" "npm run start -w login" "npm run start -w cart"
